findings.detail: typedContext copies nested specialization, gear and unlocks by reference. Mutating caller-owned objects after analyzeCohort returns changes returned typedContext without changing typedContextKey. Thus serialized source provenance can contradict its own pinned key.
findings.requestedRepair: Deep-clone validated JSON-safe typed context recursively before building output; freeze or return detached snapshot. Recompute key from detached canonical snapshot and assert JSON.stringify(typedContext) remains stable after caller mutation.

findings.detail: validateContext treats nonfinite and non-JSON-safe nested profession fields as known. NaN and Infinity serialize identically to null in typedContextKey; functions and undefined nested values silently disappear. Synthetic RAW-shaped cohorts with distinct unsupported nested contexts can collide.
findings.requestedRepair: Validate all nested profession context leaves as finite, explicit JSON-safe primitives/arrays/objects under a typed schema. Reject undefined, NaN, Infinity, functions and unsupported values recursively; canonicalize nested key order if object order is not semantically meaningful. Never infer unknown from null or omit fields.
